values.meaning: mana refunded if the channel is not recast

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt only on recast, when Varus fires the arrow in the target direction; the charge itself deals no damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Varus''' fires a piercing arrow in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Damage and detonated Blighted Quiver stacks scale up with channel/charge time, at 2% per 0.05 seconds up to a cap of 1.25 seconds (i.e. reaching maximum at 1.25s of charging).
mechanics.quote: The damage of the arrow as well as any detonated ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks are both increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 50 for 6|0 to 1.25|formula=2% per 0.05 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}

mechanics.claim: If the channel completes its full duration without being recast, the cast is cancelled (no damage dealt) and half the mana cost is refunded.
mechanics.quote: If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Piercing Arrow'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}}

mechanics.claim: Arrow damage is reduced per additional enemy hit, 15% per enemy up to a 67% maximum reduction (irrelevant on a single-target dummy).
mechanics.quote: the arrow's damage is reduced by {{pp|type=number of enemies hit|key=%|0 to 60 for 5;67|0 to 5|formula=0% + (15% per enemy hit). ''This is capped at a maximum of 67%.''}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the recast (post-effect), and is reduced by the amount of time spent charging.
mechanics.quote: Starts post-effect, after charge ends the cooldown is reduced equal to the charge duration

mechanics.claim: At maximum damage charge, the hit shows cosmetic critical-strike text only, with no gameplay effect.
mechanics.quote: At maximum damage charge, all damage caused by ''Piercing Arrow'' will trigger {{ccs||magic}}{{ccs|cosmetic critical strike|physical|link=true|tip=false}} text.
